changes: Fixed the real cause of "both my cards show at the same time" (dealer's own animation was already fine). Whoever taps Deal gets an immediate re-render right after their own server call succeeds, and the real-time listener ALSO fires independently for that same underlying write — often within milliseconds. That second render used to see the animation-tracking state already marked as done from the first one, so it rendered the exact same cards again instantly with zero animation, visually snapping mid-animation to the final static state. This mattered most for whoever actually dealt, since only their client gets both triggers firing back to back.

Fixed by delaying when a card gets marked as "already animated" until the animation would have genuinely finished playing — a near-simultaneous second render now re-plays the same animation instead of cutting it short. Confirmed the fix with a direct timing simulation before shipping it, not just reasoned through it. Applied to both the dealer's own cards and every seat's hand.
